programs.description: After being accused of stealing from the temple, Ganga, a bold and extroverted woman, flees to the city. However, she returns in order to prove her innocence and save her brother.
Aadhya, a celebrated author with a controversial book to her credit, must fight for survival in a cafe full of people who have motives for killing her.
The host interacts with popular Gujarati singer Umesh Barot about his career in music. Later, the artist shares the stories behind some of his most famous folk songs.
Mukesh Bhambhani and his spouse Neeta participate in an amusing domestic dispute. Consequently, this entertaining rivalry generates immense laughter.
Narsinh Mehta is a poet and saint of Gujarat, who is just like any other person facing several hardships and struggles in his life.
